transcript.text: Hobs can stop working properly for several reasons, often starting with simple settings like a child lock being active or using pans that aren't suitable for induction if you have that type. It could also be an issue with the power supply to the unit or a specific heating zone failing. To help narrow this down safely, please first check if there is a key or padlock symbol on your control panel and ensure the child lock isn't engaged. Then, try switching one of the zones on again to see if it responds now.
no padlock symbol showing. it's just the back right ring that doesn't heat up, the other three are fine. it's a ceramic hob, Zanussi

Since you've confirmed there's no child lock active and only one specific zone on your ceramic hob isn't heating, this usually points to a localized issue like a failed radiant element or its control switch rather than a system-wide fault. To help identify the correct replacement part for that back right ring, I'll need the model number of your Zanussi hob. You can typically find this on a label located on the underside of the unit or sometimes on the guarantee card if you still have it. If you can't reach the label easily at the moment, we can certainly wait until you're able to check.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]
I haven't got the full model number, sorry. The manual cover just says it starts with ZHRN but I can't see the rest. It's about 8 years old.

Yes, you can try placing a suitable pan on the back right ring and turning it on to see if it heats up at all. If it still doesn't respond after confirming there is no child lock active, this likely points to a faulty radiant element or its control switch for that specific zone.
I tried it with a pan on the back right ring. The display shows the power level when I select it, but the ring doesn't glow red and the pan stays cold. The other three rings are fine.
